column4: SELECT id, CAST(staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS staked_tokens, CAST(locked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS locked_tokens, CAST(delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS delegated_tokens, CAST(allocated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS allocated_tokens, allocation_count, indexing_reward_cut, query_fee_cut, last_delegation_parameter_update, CAST(rewards_earned AS VARCHAR) AS rewards_earned, CAST(query_fees_collected AS VARCHAR) AS query_fees_collected, CAST(delegator_shares AS VARCHAR) AS delegator_shares, url, geohash, created_at FROM lodestar_indexers i WHERE i.staked_tokens > 0 AND i.id <> '0xb43b2cccceada5292732a8c58ae134adefce09bb' ORDER BY i.staked_tokens DESC, i.id ASC LIMIT 100 OFFSET 0

SELECT id, start_block, end_block, CAST(signalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS signalled_tokens, CAST(stake_deposited AS VARCHAR) AS stake_deposited, CAST(total_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS total_rewards, CAST(total_indexer_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS total_indexer_rewards, CAST(total_delegator_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS total_delegator_rewards, CAST(query_fees_collected AS VARCHAR) AS query_fees_collected, CAST(curator_query_fees AS VARCHAR) AS curator_query_fees, CAST(taxed_query_fees AS VARCHAR) AS taxed_query_fees FROM lodestar_epochs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

column4: SELECT delegation_ratio, curation_tax_percentage, protocol_payment_cut, max_thawing_period_seconds, epoch_length, last_length_update_epoch, last_length_update_block, CAST(total_curation_tax AS VARCHAR) AS total_curation_tax, CAST(total_protocol_tax AS VARCHAR) AS total_protocol_tax FROM lodestar_network_params

SELECT id, CAST(staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS staked_tokens, CAST(locked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS locked_tokens, locked_until, CAST(delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS delegated_tokens, CAST(delegated_thawing_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS delegated_thawing_tokens, CAST(allocated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS allocated_tokens, allocation_count, indexing_reward_cut, query_fee_cut, last_delegation_parameter_update, CAST(rewards_earned AS VARCHAR) AS rewards_earned, CAST(query_fees_collected AS VARCHAR) AS query_fees_collected, CAST(delegator_shares AS VARCHAR) AS delegator_shares, CAST(provisioned_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS provisioned_tokens, delegator_count, url, geohash, created_at FROM lodestar_indexers WHERE id = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4'

SELECT operator FROM (SELECT LOWER(operator) AS operator, allowed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY LOWER(operator) ORDER BY block_number DESC, log_index DESC) AS rn FROM ( SELECT operator, allowed, block_number, log_index FROM staking__operator_set WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT operator, allowed, block_number, log_index FROM staking_legacy__set_operator WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4')) WHERE rn = 1 AND allowed ORDER BY operator

WITH events AS ( SELECT LOWER(delegator) AS delegator, 'in' AS kind, CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT) AS tok, CAST(shares AS HUGEINT) AS sh FROM staking_legacy__stake_delegated WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'out', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(shares AS HUGEINT) FROM staking_legacy__stake_delegated_locked WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'in', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(shares AS HUGEINT) FROM staking__tokens_delegated WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'out', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(shares AS HUGEINT) FROM staking__tokens_undelegated WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4'), positions AS (SELECT delegator, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'in' THEN sh ELSE -sh END) AS share_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'in' THEN tok ELSE 0 END) AS total_delegated_tokens FROM events GROUP BY 1) SELECT delegator || '-' || '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AS id, delegator, CAST(total_delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS staked_tokens, CAST(share_amount AS VARCHAR) AS share_amount FROM positions WHERE share_amount > 0 ORDER BY total_delegated_tokens DESC, delegator ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT a.id, CAST(a.allocated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS allocated_tokens, a.created_at_epoch, a.subgraph_deployment, CAST(a.signalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS signalled_tokens, CAST((SELECT SUM(allocated_tokens) FROM lodestar_allocations d WHERE d.subgraph_deployment = a.subgraph_deployment AND d.status = 'Active') AS VARCHAR) AS deployment_staked_tokens FROM lodestar_allocations a WHERE LOWER(a.indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND a.status = 'Active' ORDER BY a.id

SELECT id, CAST(allocated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS allocated_tokens, created_at_epoch, closed_at_epoch, closed_at, CAST(indexing_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS indexing_rewards, CAST(query_fees_collected AS VARCHAR) AS query_fees_collected, poi, force_closed, subgraph_deployment FROM lodestar_allocations WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND status = 'Closed' ORDER BY closed_at DESC, id LIMIT 500
SELECT delegation_ratio FROM lodestar_network_params

WITH events AS ( SELECT LOWER(delegator) AS delegator, 'in' AS kind, CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT) AS tok, CAST(shares AS HUGEINT) AS sh, CAST(block_timestamp AS BIGINT) AS ts FROM staking_legacy__stake_delegated WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'lock', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(shares AS HUGEINT), CAST(block_timestamp AS BIGINT) FROM staking_legacy__stake_delegated_locked WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'in', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(shares AS HUGEINT), CAST(block_timestamp AS BIGINT) FROM staking__tokens_delegated WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'thaw', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(shares AS HUGEINT), CAST(block_timestamp AS BIGINT) FROM staking__tokens_undelegated WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'unlock', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(0 AS HUGEINT), CAST(block_timestamp AS BIGINT) FROM staking__stake_delegated_withdrawn WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT LOWER(delegator), 'release', CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT), CAST(0 AS HUGEINT), CAST(block_timestamp AS BIGINT) FROM staking__delegated_tokens_withdrawn WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4'), positions AS (SELECT delegator, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'in' THEN sh WHEN kind IN ('lock', 'thaw') THEN -sh ELSE 0 END) AS share_amount, SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'in' THEN tok ELSE 0 END) AS total_delegated_tokens, GREATEST(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'thaw' THEN tok WHEN kind = 'release' THEN -tok ELSE 0 END), 0) AS thawing_tokens, GREATEST(SUM(CASE WHEN kind = 'lock' THEN tok WHEN kind = 'unlock' THEN -tok ELSE 0 END), 0) AS locked_tokens, MIN(ts) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'in') AS delegated_at, MAX(ts) AS last_change_at FROM events GROUP BY 1), thaw AS (SELECT LOWER(owner) AS delegator, MAX(CAST("thawingUntil" AS BIGINT)) AS thawing_until FROM staking__thaw_request_created WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND CAST("requestType" AS INTEGER) IN (1, 2) GROUP BY 1), pool AS (SELECT delegator_shares, delegated_tokens FROM lodestar_indexer_pool WHERE id = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4') SELECT p.delegator || '-' || '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AS id, p.delegator, CAST(p.share_amount AS VARCHAR) AS share_amount, CAST(CASE WHEN pool.delegator_shares > 0 THEN (p.share_amount // pool.delegator_shares) * pool.delegated_tokens + CAST(CAST(p.share_amount % pool.delegator_shares AS DOUBLE) * CAST(pool.delegated_tokens AS DOUBLE) / CAST(pool.delegator_shares AS DOUBLE) AS HUGEINT) ELSE 0 END AS VARCHAR) AS current_tokens, CAST(p.total_delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS total_delegated_tokens, CAST(p.thawing_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS thawing_tokens, CASE WHEN p.thawing_tokens > 0 THEN t.thawing_until END AS thawing_until, CAST(p.locked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS locked_tokens, p.delegated_at, p.last_change_at, CAST(pool.delegator_shares AS VARCHAR) AS pool_shares, CAST(pool.delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS pool_tokens, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.share_amount > 0) OVER () AS active FROM positions p LEFT JOIN thaw t ON t.delegator = p.delegator CROSS JOIN pool WHERE p.share_amount > 0 OR p.thawing_tokens > 0 ORDER BY p.share_amount DESC NULLS LAST, p.delegator ASC LIMIT 25 OFFSET 0

column4: SELECT indexer, day_start, CAST(total_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS total_rewards, CAST(indexer_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_rewards, CAST(delegator_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS delegator_rewards, CAST(reward_count AS BIGINT) AS reward_count, CAST(fees_gross AS VARCHAR) AS fees_gross, CAST(fees_curators AS VARCHAR) AS fees_curators, CAST(fees_protocol AS VARCHAR) AS fees_protocol, CAST(fees_net AS VARCHAR) AS fees_net, CAST(fee_count AS BIGINT) AS fee_count FROM lodestar_indexer_daily WHERE indexer = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND day_start >= 1783296000 ORDER BY day_start DESC

SELECT day_start, CAST(indexer_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_rewards, CAST(total_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS total_rewards, CAST(fees_net AS VARCHAR) AS fees_net, CAST(fees_gross AS VARCHAR) AS fees_gross FROM lodestar_indexer_daily WHERE indexer = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND day_start >= 1788480000 AND (reward_count > 0 OR fee_count > 0) ORDER BY day_start

SELECT deployment, CAST(SUM(indexer_rewards) AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_rewards, CAST(SUM(total_rewards) AS VARCHAR) AS total_rewards, CAST(SUM(fees_net) AS VARCHAR) AS fees_net, CAST(SUM(fees_gross) AS VARCHAR) AS fees_gross FROM lodestar_indexer_deployment_daily WHERE indexer = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND day_start >= 1788480000 GROUP BY deployment

SELECT LOWER(indexer) AS indexer, subgraph_deployment, CAST(SUM(allocated_tokens) AS VARCHAR) AS allocated_tokens FROM lodestar_allocations WHERE status = 'Active' AND subgraph_deployment IN (SELECT subgraph_deployment FROM lodestar_allocations WHERE LOWER(indexer) = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND status = 'Active') GROUP BY 1, 2

SELECT id, CAST(total_staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS total_staked_tokens, CAST(total_unstaked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS total_unstaked_tokens, CAST(total_realized_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS total_realized_rewards, stakes_count, active_stakes_count FROM lodestar_delegators WHERE id = '0x15f72b52cd79928b66fe9887acd20057203a97b1'

WITH s AS (SELECT p.id, p.indexer, p.total_delegated_tokens, p.share_amount, p.locked_tokens, p.locked_until, p.realized_rewards, p.total_undelegated_tokens, p.created_at, p.last_undelegated_at, p.active, CASE WHEN i.delegator_shares > 0 THEN (p.share_amount // i.delegator_shares) * i.delegated_tokens + CAST(CAST(p.share_amount % i.delegator_shares AS DOUBLE) * CAST(i.delegated_tokens AS DOUBLE) / CAST(i.delegator_shares AS DOUBLE) AS HUGEINT) ELSE 0 END AS staked_tokens, i.staked_tokens AS indexer_staked_tokens, i.delegated_tokens AS indexer_delegated_tokens, i.delegated_thawing_tokens AS indexer_delegated_thawing_tokens, i.delegator_shares AS indexer_delegator_shares, i.indexing_reward_cut, i.query_fee_cut, i.allocation_count, i.url, i.geohash FROM lodestar_delegator_positions p LEFT JOIN lodestar_indexers i ON i.id = p.indexer WHERE p.delegator = '0x15f72b52cd79928b66fe9887acd20057203a97b1') SELECT id, indexer, CAST(total_delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS staked_tokens, CAST(staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS current_tokens, CAST(share_amount AS VARCHAR) AS share_amount, CAST(locked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS locked_tokens, locked_until, CAST(realized_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS realized_rewards, CAST(total_undelegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS unstaked_tokens, created_at, last_undelegated_at, active, CAST(indexer_staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_staked_tokens, CAST(indexer_delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_delegated_tokens, CAST(indexer_delegated_thawing_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_delegated_thawing_tokens, CAST(indexer_delegator_shares AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_delegator_shares, indexing_reward_cut, query_fee_cut, allocation_count, url, geohash FROM s ORDER BY staked_tokens DESC, indexer LIMIT 200

WITH s AS (SELECT p.id, p.indexer, p.total_delegated_tokens, p.share_amount, p.locked_tokens, p.locked_until, p.realized_rewards, p.total_undelegated_tokens, p.created_at, p.last_undelegated_at, p.active, CASE WHEN i.delegator_shares > 0 THEN (p.share_amount // i.delegator_shares) * i.delegated_tokens + CAST(CAST(p.share_amount % i.delegator_shares AS DOUBLE) * CAST(i.delegated_tokens AS DOUBLE) / CAST(i.delegator_shares AS DOUBLE) AS HUGEINT) ELSE 0 END AS staked_tokens, i.staked_tokens AS indexer_staked_tokens, i.delegated_tokens AS indexer_delegated_tokens, i.delegated_thawing_tokens AS indexer_delegated_thawing_tokens, i.delegator_shares AS indexer_delegator_shares, i.indexing_reward_cut, i.query_fee_cut, i.allocation_count, i.url, i.geohash FROM lodestar_delegator_positions p LEFT JOIN lodestar_indexers i ON i.id = p.indexer WHERE p.delegator = '0x15f72b52cd79928b66fe9887acd20057203a97b1' AND p.active) SELECT id, indexer, CAST(total_delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS staked_tokens, CAST(staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS current_tokens, CAST(share_amount AS VARCHAR) AS share_amount, CAST(locked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS locked_tokens, locked_until, CAST(realized_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS realized_rewards, CAST(total_undelegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS unstaked_tokens, created_at, last_undelegated_at, active, CAST(indexer_staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_staked_tokens, CAST(indexer_delegated_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_delegated_tokens, CAST(indexer_delegated_thawing_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_delegated_thawing_tokens, CAST(indexer_delegator_shares AS VARCHAR) AS indexer_delegator_shares, indexing_reward_cut, query_fee_cut, allocation_count, url, geohash FROM s ORDER BY staked_tokens DESC, indexer LIMIT 100

SELECT id, CAST(total_signalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS total_signalled_tokens, CAST(total_unsignalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS total_unsignalled_tokens, CAST(realized_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS realized_rewards, signal_count, active_signal_count FROM lodestar_curators WHERE id = '0xec9a7fb6cbc2e41926127929c2dce6e9c5d33bec'

SELECT id, subgraph_deployment, CAST(signalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS signalled_tokens, CAST(unsignalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS unsignalled_tokens, CAST(signal AS VARCHAR) AS signal, last_signal_change, CAST(realized_rewards AS VARCHAR) AS realized_rewards, CAST(deployment_signalled_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS deployment_signalled_tokens, CAST(deployment_query_fees_amount AS VARCHAR) AS deployment_query_fees_amount, CAST(deployment_staked_tokens AS VARCHAR) AS deployment_staked_tokens FROM lodestar_curator_signals s WHERE s.curator = '0xec9a7fb6cbc2e41926127929c2dce6e9c5d33bec' ORDER BY s.signalled_tokens DESC, s.subgraph_deployment LIMIT 200

SELECT p.id, p.indexer, p.data_service, CAST(p.tokens_provisioned AS VARCHAR) AS tokens_provisioned, CAST(COALESCE(p.tokens_allocated, 0) AS VARCHAR) AS tokens_allocated, CAST(p.tokens_thawing AS VARCHAR) AS tokens_thawing, p.max_verifier_cut, p.thawing_period, p.created_at, COALESCE(p.allocation_count, 0) AS allocation_count, CAST(COALESCE(p.rewards_earned, 0) AS VARCHAR) AS rewards_earned, CAST(COALESCE(p.query_fees_collected, 0) AS VARCHAR) AS query_fees_collected FROM lodestar_provisions p WHERE p.indexer = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND p.tokens_provisioned > 0 ORDER BY p.tokens_provisioned DESC, p.data_service
SELECT result FROM max_thawing_period WHERE NOT reverted ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT data_service, CAST(SUM(tokens_provisioned) AS VARCHAR) AS total_tokens_provisioned, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(tokens_allocated, 0)) AS VARCHAR) AS total_tokens_allocated FROM lodestar_provisions WHERE data_service IN ('0xb2bb92d0de618878e438b55d5846cfecd9301105') GROUP BY 1

SELECT LOWER(c.verifier) AS data_service, c."thawRequestId" AS id, c.shares, c."thawingUntil" AS thawing_until, c.nonce, c.block_timestamp AS created_at, c.tx_hash FROM staking__thaw_request_created c WHERE c."requestType" = '0' AND LOWER(c."serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM staking__thaw_request_fulfilled f WHERE f."thawRequestId" = c."thawRequestId") ORDER BY CAST(c."thawingUntil" AS BIGINT), c.block_number, c.log_index

WITH created AS (SELECT * FROM staking__thaw_request_created WHERE "requestType" = '0' AND LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4') SELECT 'ProvisionCreated' AS kind, LOWER(verifier) AS data_service, tokens, NULL AS shares, NULL AS thawing_until, NULL AS thaw_request_id, NULL AS valid, NULL AS payment_type, NULL AS fee_cut, 1 AS events, block_number, log_index, block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM staking__provision_created WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT 'ProvisionIncreased', LOWER(verifier), CAST(SUM(CAST(tokens AS HUGEINT)) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, COUNT(*), block_number, MAX(log_index), block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM staking__provision_increased WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' GROUP BY LOWER(verifier), block_number, block_timestamp, tx_hash UNION ALL SELECT 'ProvisionThawed', LOWER(verifier), tokens, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, block_number, log_index, block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM staking__provision_thawed WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT 'TokensDeprovisioned', LOWER(verifier), tokens, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, block_number, log_index, block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM staking__tokens_deprovisioned WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT 'ProvisionSlashed', LOWER(verifier), tokens, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, block_number, log_index, block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM staking__provision_slashed WHERE LOWER("serviceProvider") = '0xf92f430dd8567b0d466358c79594ab58d919a6d4' UNION ALL SELECT 'ThawRequestCreated', LOWER(verifier), NULL, shares, "thawingUntil", "thawRequestId", NULL, NULL, NULL, 1, block_number, log_index, block_timestamp, tx_hash FROM created UNION ALL SELECT 'ThawRequestFulfilled', LOWER(c.verifier), f.tokens, f.shares, f."thawingUntil", f."thawRequestId", f.valid, NULL, NULL, 1, f.block_number, f.log_index, f.block_timestamp, f.tx_hash FROM staking__thaw_request_fulfilled f JOIN created c ON c."thawRequestId" = f."thawRequestId" UNION ALL SELECT 'DelegationFeeCutSet', LOWER(verifier), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, "paymentType", "feeCut", 1, block_number, log_index, block_timestamp, column4: WITH fees AS (SELECT tx_hash, LOWER(payer) AS payer, LOWER("serviceProvider") AS receiver, CAST("tokensCollected" AS VARCHAR) AS tokens, "allocationId" AS allocation_id, CAST("tokensCollected" AS VARCHAR) AS fee_tokens, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tx_hash, LOWER(payer), LOWER("serviceProvider"), CAST("tokensCollected" AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY log_index) AS rn FROM subgraph_service__query_fees_collected), esc AS (SELECT tx_hash, log_index, payer, receiver, tokens, block_timestamp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tx_hash, LOWER(payer), LOWER(receiver), CAST(tokens AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY log_index) AS rn FROM escrow__escrow_collected WHERE LOWER(collector) = '0x8f69f5c07477ac46fbc491b1e6d91e2bb0111a9e') SELECT c.tx_hash, c.log_index, c.payer, c.receiver, CAST(c.tokens AS VARCHAR) AS tokens, c.block_timestamp, f.allocation_id, f.fee_tokens FROM escrow__escrow_collected c LEFT JOIN esc e ON e.tx_hash = c.tx_hash AND e.log_index = c.log_index LEFT JOIN fees f ON f.tx_hash = e.tx_hash AND f.payer = LOWER(e.payer) AND f.receiver = LOWER(e.receiver) AND f.tokens = CAST(e.tokens AS VARCHAR) AND f.rn = e.rn WHERE c.block_timestamp >= 1790899200 ORDER BY c.block_timestamp, c.tx_hash, c.log_index LIMIT 10000
